episode_id: Bring my configuration up to date with the setting names the app uses now. Rename the old key in my own override file, and keep that file out of git./seed-2-config_renamed-29979

reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 2 same-intent states (config_renamed seed 2 resolves to 'migrate_local', which accepts ['migrate_local']), and that is the state the program was compiled from: it declares variant 'rename', but the solution it was compiled from is a 'migrate_local' resolution there, so the declared variant, not the preconditions, is what is wrong

refused_program.body:
tmp=$(mktemp)
if awk '
  FNR == NR {
    sub(/#.*/, "")
    if ($0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*$/) next
    eq = index($0, "=")
    if (!eq) next
    old = substr($0, 1, eq - 1)
    new = substr($0, eq + 1)
    gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", old)
    gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", new)
    if (old != "" && new != "") map[old] = new
    next
  }
  {
    line = $0
    if (match(line, /^[[:space:]]*[^=[:space:]]+[[:space:]]*=/)) {
      prefix = substr(line, 1, RLENGTH)
      lead = prefix
      sub(/[^[:space:]].*$/, "", lead)
      rest = substr(prefix, length(lead) + 1)
      key = rest
      sub(/[[:space:]]*=.*$/, "", key)
      if (key in map) {
        between = rest
        sub(/^[^[:space:]]*/, "", between)
        sub(/=.*$/, "", between)
        line = lead map[key] between "=" substr(line, RLENGTH + 1)
      }
    }
    print line
  }
' config/renames.conf config/local.conf > "$tmp"; then
  cat "$tmp" > config/local.conf
  rm -f "$tmp"
else
  rm -f "$tmp"
  exit 1
fi
refused_program.intent: Rename stale configuration keys in the ignored local override file according to the mapping in config/renames.conf, without tracking the file.

postconditions.description: no old key from config/renames.conf remains in config/local.conf
postconditions.name: no_old_keys_remain
postconditions.probe:
test -f config/renames.conf || exit 1
while IFS= read -r line; do
  line=${line%%#*}
  old=${line%%=*}
  [ "$old" = "$line" ] && continue
  old=$(printf '%s' "$old" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$old" ] && continue
  if grep -Eq "^[[:space:]]*$old[[:space:]]*=" config/local.conf; then
    exit 1
  fi
done < config/renames.conf
exit 0

postconditions.description: config/local.conf is still ignored by git and not tracked
postconditions.name: local_override_still_ignored_untracked
postconditions.probe:
test -f config/local.conf &&
git check-ignore -q config/local.conf &&
! git ls-files --error-unmatch -- config/local.conf >/dev/null 2>&1

postconditions.description: at least one new key from config/renames.conf is present in config/local.conf

found=0

  line=${line%%#*}
  old=${line%%=*}
  [ "$old" = "$line" ] && continue
  new=${line#*=}

preconditions.description: none of the old keys present in config/local.conf already have their new key set
preconditions.name: no_conflicting_new_key
preconditions.probe:
test -f config/renames.conf || exit 1
while IFS= read -r line; do
  line=${line%%#*}
  old=${line%%=*}
  [ "$old" = "$line" ] && continue
  new=${line#*=}
  old=$(printf '%s' "$old" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  new=$(printf '%s' "$new" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$old" ] && [ -n "$new" ] || continue
  if grep -Eq "^[[:space:]]*$old[[:space:]]*=" config/local.conf; then
    if grep -Eq "^[[:space:]]*$new[[:space:]]*=" config/local.conf; then
      exit 1
    fi
  fi
done < config/renames.conf
exit 0
